source_assessments.inspection: PDF pages 1, 2 and 97 visually checked: Hydroboracite, CaMg[B3O4(OH)3]2(H2O)3, G, 1834, Kazakhstan. Current authority home inspected from saved live acquisition.
source_assessments.limits: 1834 is original-description year, not an IMA approval identifier; no criticality designation inferred.
source_assessments.license: CC BY-SA3.0 Unported stated on PDF2; no PDF redistributed.

source_assessments.inspection: Complete six-page paper and rendered pages inspected, including Tables 1-8 and Figures 1-3. Bigadiç natural crystal, 0.35 x 0.09 x 0.05 mm; P2/c, Z=2; 1846 independent reflections, 1428 observed. Diffuse H residuals led to geometrically assigned positions; hydrogen parameters were not refined.
source_assessments.limits: Single natural crystal; no new independent chemistry table. CISTI structure-factor deposit mentioned on p. 78 was not acquired. No invented DOI. The 2026 manuscript methods misattribute Via Lamarmora as part of the author list; actual 1978 authors are Cesare Sabelli and Andrea Stoppioni.
source_assessments.license: Redistribution terms not established; raw PDF retained outside Git.

source_assessments.role: primary abiotic thermal transformation and mixed-feed context
source_assessments.inspection: All text read; Tables 1-3, Graphs 1-12 and Photos 1-23 inspected visually using full pages and contact sheets. Column 8 feed: 46.39% B2O3, 4.46% SiO2. Ovens at 100/150/200 degrees C; furnaces at 250-600 degrees C overnight. Water losses 22.37%/24.46%/25.26% at 400/500/600 degrees C; qualitative loss of starting crystalline order by 400 degrees C.
source_assessments.limits: Impure feed; unreported atmosphere, ramp, exact overnight hours and replicate errors. Some high-temperature residual peaks are unassigned. Text claiming all water gone at 500 degrees C contrasts with continued loss at 600; no gas-specific measurement, quantitative phase balance or isolated boron yield. The solubility ratio lacks an assay protocol and is not accepted as a quantitative claim. Hardness 5-6 differs from cited 2-3 and is not generalized to the pure species.
metadata_checks: The 1978 primary bibliography correctly identifies 1973 and pp. 104-117.
Official MTA article/show/713 gives volume 80/1973 but page range 100-112. Dergipark article 52085 gives 1973 with 100-125. Acquired English printed pagination is used for locators.
The 2026 article cites Demircioglu 2023 despite journal volume 1973; this is not treated as a new independent 2023 experiment.
source_assessments.license: Redistribution terms for acquired historical PDF not established; retained outside Git.

source_assessments.version: Physics and Chemistry of Minerals 53, 6; published 2026-02-25. Open institutional manuscript filename dated 08-01-2026; 33 PDF pages including supplementary material and references.
source_assessments.inspection: Entire extracted text inspected and all rendered page/contact sheets surveyed. Table 1, pp. 10-11, inspected at full size; Figures 2-6 and supplementary pp. 20-30 inspected. Methods pp. 4-7: two natural Bigadiç crystals, about 20 x 5 x 4 micrometres, separate DACs at ESRF ID15B, helium medium, ruby uncertainty 0.05 GPa, room temperature. Dataset 1 bracket 14.40-14.72 GPa, maximum 15.18; dataset 2 bracket 14.08-14.51, maximum 15.45. Failed recovery on decompression; high-pressure structure/space group unsolved, possibly triclinic.
source_assessments.limits: No full chemical characterization. Hydrogen omitted; O-O geometry supports inference rather than direct H tracking. Abstract, Results and Conclusions give different pressure summaries. Reported 0.9(6)% volume difference combines points from different crystals. No concrete trial, industrial deployment or recovery. Publisher current HTML has abstract, metadata, references and supplements but a subscription-limited body; version-of-record PDF not acquired.
source_assessments.license: SpringerNature TDMterms in Crossref; no open redistribution license established for manuscript/deposits. Raw material outside Git.

source_assessments.role: three crystallographic models and geometric tables from same pressure experiment
source_assessments.inspection: Three CIFs and DOCX parsed. Each CIF has 14 non-hydrogen atom rows and gives Ca2Mg2B12O34 by multiplicity times occupancy but Z=1; no H site rows. Cell metrics match first-arm Table 1 pressures 0.32, 14.40 and 7.35 GPa, respectively. DOCX contains ten tabular blocks covering two arms plus Figure S1. Units are angstrom distances, degree angles and cubic-angstrom volumes, not mg/kg observations.
source_assessments.limits: Missing pressure metadata and template fields prevent blind imports. No high-pressure-phase CIF. The Z/density discrepancy requires original correction before adopting density. Pressure rows and source column names repeat across arm/table blocks; stable keys would need file, arm, table, pressure and column. Derived geometries/models are not independent replicates or chemical assays.
source_assessments.license: No separate open reuse license established; sourcefiles retained outsideGit.
